dryRun.description: Preview the release without writing files, Git changes, pushes, or post targets.

releaseAs.description: Override the calculated bump: major, minor, patch, or an exact semantic version.

tagPrefix.description: Git tag prefix. Defaults to {projectName}@ for independent releases or v with syncVersions. Supports {projectName}.

push.description: Atomically push the current branch and release tag before post targets.

skipCommit.description: Stage release files without creating a commit. The release tag points to the existing HEAD; pushing and post targets still run.

syncVersions.description: Release all versioned workspace package manifests together, using workspace history, a shared tag (v by default), and a root changelog.

skipProjectChangelog.description: Do not read or write project changelogs. Synchronized releases still generate the root changelog and release notes.

commitMessageFormat.description: Release commit message with {projectName} and {version} placeholders. Ignored when skipCommit is true.

preid.description: Prerelease identifier such as alpha or beta. Calculated bumps start at <version>-<preid>.0; subsequent releases increment the counter unless a higher version is required. An exact releaseAs version takes precedence.
